description: Six-stage feature development lifecycle: specify -> dispatch -> impl-audit -> converge -> acceptance -> release. A scheduling prior for the host agent, not a state machine: the host may enter, skip, or exit at any stage.

steps.label: specify
steps.description: Concept -> spec v1 -> heterogeneous co-design review -> spec v2 with a correction record. Dispatch non-host-family runners with the spec-refuter-heterogeneous-v1 profile (prompts/spec-codesign.md) to refute the spec against the actual repository state. Union-merge the findings; spec-error and spec-missing findings are processed item by item; direction-disagreement findings route to the direction-review path.
steps.note: Worktree timing constraint: the specify stage is read-only end to end — no worktree is created here. Spec review and implementation must never share a worktree scope. Hosts that already mount the adversarial-audit plugin may reuse its refuter profiles for this review squad (informational note, not a plugin dependency; plugin-boundary v0 has no inter-plugin dependencies and the host decides what to mount).
steps.expected_artifact: spec-v2.md plus findings-union register with per-item adopt/reject record
steps.stop_condition: spec v2 is on disk and every spec-review finding is adopted, rejected with a falsification note, or routed to direction-review
steps.escalation: any direction-disagreement finding or needs_human signal -> direction-review path / human

steps.label: dispatch
steps.description: Implementation dispatch: sub-agents write code, the host plans and audits. Create the worktree only now — after specify has closed with spec v2 landed. Run implementation jobs through the worktree_exec sandbox so writes stay inside the worktree.
steps.note: No-questions-after-dispatch contract: every clarification is resolved before dispatch, and each dispatch prompt carries the full stop conditions. A dispatched job that needs human input mid-flight is a dispatch defect; record it and fix the brief, do not normalize interruptions.
steps.expected_artifact: worktree branch, per-task dispatch briefs, per-task implementation evidence
steps.stop_condition: every dispatched task has either produced its declared artifact or failed with a recorded cause
steps.escalation: stalled or ambiguous tasks return to the host for re-briefing; only hard blockers (missing credentials, destructive ambiguity) go to the human

steps.label: impl-audit
steps.description: Heterogeneous adversarial audit of the implementation. Auditors must not share a model family with the implementation producer. Union-merge all findings into the blocker register — no deduplication, no voting, not one finding dropped.
steps.note: Hosts that mount the adversarial-audit plugin may reuse its fan-out/convergence path and refuter profiles here (informational note, not a plugin dependency). Findings that are direction disputes rather than defects route to the direction-review path.
steps.stop_condition: every auditor has reported and every finding is registered with cited evidence
steps.escalation: contradictory findings -> host reads the cited evidence first-hand and rules; direction disputes -> direction-review path

steps.label: converge
steps.description: Per-blocker fix loop: fix adopted blockers, re-audit, repeat until HIGH+CRITICAL count converges. Exit condition is the test-pin: every invariant raised by the adversarial audit must land as a regression test. If an invariant has no pinned test, the stage is not converged — regardless of how the blocker register looks.
steps.expected_artifact: monotonically shrinking blocker register, test-pin regression test files, checkpoint commits at each convergence point
steps.stop_condition: zero open HIGH/CRITICAL blockers AND every audit-raised invariant has a passing pinned regression test
steps.escalation: non-monotonic blocker count (rebound) -> pause, re-examine audit scope or artifact before continuing

steps.label: acceptance
steps.description: Host self-check against the six acceptance gates. Read the checklist in prompts/acceptance-gate.md and walk it gate by gate: scripts green, artifacts read first-hand, adversarial findings converged, docs synced, experience captured, observability triad present. This is a host self-check, not a runner dispatch — no profile is involved.
steps.note: All six gates must hold simultaneously. Any exemption (for example the observability gate on a small fix) must record an explicit reason in the run state.
steps.expected_artifact: gate-by-gate self-check record with per-gate evidence or recorded exemption reason
steps.stop_condition: all six gates pass or carry a recorded exemption reason
steps.escalation: a gate that cannot pass and cannot be reasonably exempted -> back to converge, or to the human if the gap is a scope decision

steps.label: release
steps.description: Capture, sync, and version: write the changelog entry, align docs, record lessons/decisions into the memory or decision log, then run the repository privacy self-check in strict mode: `bash scripts/privacy_self_check.sh --repo . --strict`. If gitleaks is unavailable, run with `--no-gitleaks` and record the degradation explicitly in the run state.
steps.note: git push is always NEEDS_CONFIRM — a human must explicitly confirm every push; the path never authorizes it. Capture is a delivery action: experience not recorded means release is not done.
steps.expected_artifact: changelog entry, privacy self-check output (with any degradation recorded), capture/decision record, push confirmation record
steps.stop_condition: privacy self-check passes in strict mode (or its degradation is recorded and accepted by the human) AND the human has explicitly confirmed or declined the push
steps.escalation: any privacy self-check hit -> stop, human decides; never push to bypass

stop_conditions: spec v2 exists before any worktree is created (specify stage stays read-only)
all six acceptance gates pass simultaneously; every exemption has a recorded reason
every audit-raised invariant is pinned by a passing regression test before convergence is declared
privacy self-check ran in strict mode (degradations explicitly recorded)
git push happened only after explicit human confirmation
no permission escalation beyond what the host approved per stage
anti_patterns: ap1:skip-spec-straight-to-code — implementation starts before a reviewed spec v2 exists
ap2:self-audit-instead-of-heterogeneous — producer and auditor share a model family
ap3:missing-test-pin — convergence declared while audit-raised invariants have no regression test
ap4:implementation-done-treated-as-done — 'code complete' treated as task complete, skipping acceptance gates, docs sync, capture, and release hygiene
